currentProductGap: The owner corrected the prior natural-flow rule that treated a near-verbatim synthesis as expendable because it was 'too obvious'. Obviousness to the participant is not the relevant variable. A person-specific pattern can be obvious because the participant already knows and explicitly stated it. The current live candidate now has three distinct outcomes: generic/high-base-rate material may complete measurement without becoming a Life Pattern; a person-specific pattern copied verbatim from one participant source turn and grounded only in facts from that same source is recorded using the original participant provenance without another approval screen; any interviewer-added inference remains an ephemeral synthesis that requires participant judgment. The obsolete True-but-too-obvious control and endpoint are removed.
